summary.text: Brittney Miller is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 5 since 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brittney Miller assumed office representing Nevada State Assembly District 5 on November 9, 2016, succeeding Kyle Stephens.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Commerce and Labor, Judiciary (as chair), and Legislative Operations and Elections committees.
Her Republican opponent in the 2026 general election is Kelly Quinn.
